title: Growing Up and Old Age
seo_title: Year 5 Science: Growing Up and Old Age Worksheets (Human Life Stages and Growth)
standard_text: Describe the changes as humans develop to old age.
meta_desc: Free Year 5 science worksheets on how humans change from birth to old age: life stages, puberty, growth in height and mass, and changes in old age. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: We grow fastest as babies, change in puberty and stop growing taller at about 20.
body_html:
How to think about it

Humans change as they grow from babies to older adults.

  • Baby → toddler → child → teenager → adult → older adult.
  • We grow fastest in the first year. In puberty, hormones change a child's body into an adult's, with a growth spurt. Height stops increasing at about 20.
  • In old age, hair may turn grey, skin wrinkles, bones and muscles get weaker, and eyesight and hearing may fade.
Example

Height 50 cm at birth, 75 cm at 1. Growth?

75 − 50

Answer: 25 cm in one year

Example

Birth mass 3.5 kg, tripled at 1 year?

3.5 × 3

Answer: 10.5 kg

Common mistakes

  • Thinking people grow fastest as teenagers (it is the first year).
  • Thinking adults keep growing taller.
  • Thinking puberty starts at the same age for everyone.

faq.q: What are the stages of human life?
faq.a: Baby, toddler, child, teenager (adolescent), adult and older adult. Each stage brings different changes to the body.
In the first year of life, when a baby can grow about 25 cm. There is another growth spurt during puberty.

faq.q: What changes happen in old age?
faq.a: Hair may turn grey, skin becomes thinner and wrinkled, bones and muscles can weaken, and eyesight and hearing often get worse.

c: A toddler cannot walk or talk yet and needs milk and care from adults.
A toddler has stopped growing taller and may have children of their own.
A toddler is learning to walk and say first words.
A toddler may have grey hair, wrinkles and weaker bones.
items.e: Each stage has its own changes.

items.q: A baby has a mass of 3.4 kg at birth. Babies usually triple their birth mass by about 1 year old. About what mass will the baby be then?
Is this a common change in old age? Skin becomes thinner and wrinkled.
c: Yes, this often happens as people get older.
No, this only happens to babies.
No, this never happens to people.
items.e: Bodies change in old age; exercise and good food help.
